title: Miftah tutorial 47 · A tenancy contract from draft to cleared cheques
description:
Follow one contract end to end: draft it with a cheque of its own for the deposit and the fee, post it, bank the cheques that are due and clear them when the bank confirms.

Who this is for: Company Admin, Property Manager.
